feeds.name: USDA FNS Summer Meals Site Finder 2026 (SummerSiteFinder2026_Point Layer)
feeds.owner: USDA Food and Nutrition Service (ArcGIS owner william.staggs_USDA_FNS)
feeds.license_terms: No licenseInfo on item. Produced by a US federal agency (USDA FNS) -> US government work, generally public domain (17 USC 105). Data supplied by state agency (VDOE SNP). Exclude Contact_First_Name/Contact_Last_Name (personal data) - query_url selects only site fields.
feeds.est_records_in_nova: 204 (Fairfax Co 101, Prince William 51, Loudoun 32, Arlington 9, Alexandria 6, Manassas 4, Manassas Park 1; Falls Church/Fairfax City 0). 1851 VA rows total.
feeds.notes: Service name contains '(Testing)' but it is the source behind USDA's public 2026 Site Finder experience. Summer 2026 season has ENDED (End_date ~Aug 2026) - import as seasonal/expired or wait for 2027 layer. Filter Dropped='False'. County name values are lower-case 'city' (e.g. 'Alexandria city').

feeds.name: HRSA Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites (CSV)
feeds.owner: HRSA Bureau of Primary Health Care (data.hrsa.gov)
feeds.format: CSV (national, ~14 MB, 19,387 rows); filter column 'State and County Federal Information Processing Standard Code' IN (51013,51059,51600,51610,51510,51107,51153,51683,51685)
feeds.license_terms: US federal government work (public domain, 17 USC 105); HRSA publishes as open data download.
feeds.robots_ok: NO for AI agents: data.hrsa.gov/robots.txt has 'Disallow: /' for ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, GPTBot, etc. (no rule for generic agents). Fetched once (single request) during this research before reading robots; no further automated fetches and no sample saved. Recommend a human or the Lantern backend (non-AI, identified UA) download it.
feeds.est_records_in_nova: 29 active sites (Fairfax Co 13, Alexandria 5, Arlington 4, Manassas 2, Prince William 2, Loudoun 2, Fairfax City 1); grantees: Neighborhood Health 19, Loudoun Community Health Center 6, Greater Prince William Area CHC 4

fields.name: Site Name (+ Health Center Name)
fields.hours: Operating Hours per Week, Health Center Operational Schedule Description
fields.category: Health Center Type Description, Health Center Location Type Description, Health Center Service Delivery Site Location Setting Description
fields.coords: Geocoding Artifact Address Primary X/Y Coordinate

feeds.last_updated: Data Warehouse Record Create Date column (daily refresh per HRSA)
feeds.notes: Highest-quality federal health-clinic feed: phone, web, hours. Sliding-fee FQHCs - ideal for Lantern.

feeds.name: SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov locator (behavioral health treatment facilities)
feeds.format: JSON (radius query: sAddr=lat,lon, limitType=2 means radius in meters; paged via page/pageSize)
feeds.license_terms: US federal government data (SAMHSA N-SUMHSS/locator) - public domain (17 USC 105). No explicit license on the endpoint.
feeds.est_records_in_nova: ~110: radius 30 mi from (38.85,-77.35) returned 334 rows, 113 in VA (incl. 2 Warrenton + 2 Stafford outside scope). typeFacility MH 64, SA 46, OTP 3. Western Loudoun may need a second radius query (e.g. sAddr=39.1,-77.6).

fields.name: name1 (+name2)
fields.category: typeFacility (MH/SA/OTP/BUPREN), services[] (f2 codes: TC type of care, SET setting, PAY payment, AGE, SG special groups, ...)
fields.id: none stable - build hash of name1+street1+zip+typeFacility

feeds.notes: Same facility can appear twice (once per typeFacility). Many private-pay providers; use PAY codes to prefer sliding-fee/Medicaid/free. Filter state=='VA' and NoVA zips.
